targets.rationale: The email requires a judges thank-you follow-up after the recap, with no exact elapsed interval. The model created the correctly identified to-do for September 26 at the default 5pm, after the September 25 recap. The key's exact September 27 requirement invents a two-day offset. Rejecting September 26 solely as the wrong day is therefore unjustified. Complete before/after stores show one new judges task, todo_70, and no duplicate or competing judges object. This establishes appropriate task tracking, not actual delivery of the thank-you note.

evidence.observation: Observed target body: "Hey Mark, after the recap, could you send a short thank you note to the judges? They put in a lot of time and a few words from you would mean a lot." No two-day offset appears.
The recap proposal says "Thinking Friday, September 25th, 2026 if that works." Same-day headcount confirms the recap without revising its date.

create_todo used email_id Innovation-comp.post-recap-follow-ups, title "Send thank you note to pitch comp judges", due_date "2026-09-26T17:00:00", description "After recap - judges put in a lot of time, note from CEO would mean a lot"; successful result returned id todo_70.
All 37 events and 28 pre-existing to-dos remain unchanged. The after-store adds todo_70 and the unrelated slide-review task todo_71. Recap evt_62 remains September 25, 10am-11am.
The key is {"eq":"@recap_meeting+2d"}, tolerance exact_day, resolving to September 27. The reported failure identifies September 26 5pm as the wrong day.

ambiguity_or_missing_evidence: There is no specified upper deadline. The instructions' description of to-dos as tasks with deadlines creates some uncertainty about whether an undated follow-up must be tracked, but does not justify an exact September 27 key or make this reasonable post-recap reminder incorrect.
Earlier storyline completion language conflicts with its explicit dates. No supplied message revises the September 25 recap or says the thank-you note was already sent.

historical_observations.observation: The historical recap event was created at 10am despite the recap email supplying only a date and the assistant instructions defaulting events to 9am. This separate time-default issue does not affect the supported September 25 day or the correctness of a September 26 follow-up.
